generated_by: Phase A0 Gate 2 — Capability Ontology + Counts

definitions.agent_preset: A Corti Console template selectable from the New Agent picker; lives in Corti's database, not in iCoDer's filesystem.
definitions.agent_pack: An iCoDer manifest package directory containing agent_pack.json; the canonical unit of distribution. Lives under backend/official_agents/{name}/.
definitions.agent_definition: A persistent Agent configuration stored in RuntimeAgentRegistry (DB-backed). Can be a clone of an Agent Pack, or a user-created agent. Distinct from the pack itself.
definitions.runtime_agent: An executable identity loadable by RuntimeAgentRegistry at run time. Implies the pack has maturity=runnable or maturity=mvp AND a registered execution path.
definitions.expert: An Orchestrator-dispatched capability with its own I/O, permissions, and trace events. Modeled after Corti's 14 prebuilt Experts (Memory, Medical Coding, PubMed, etc.). Concretely in iCoDer: a class registered in CapabilityRegistry that the CortiLikeOrchestrator can dispatch to.
definitions.workflow_gate: A CDI-internal deterministic check (e.g., nlq_gate, query_eligibility_gate, claim_evidence_gate). NOT a Corti-style Expert. Lives under app/icoder/agent_runtime/cdi/.
definitions.tool: A deterministic callable exposed to an agent via tool-calling. Lives under app/icoder/mcp/handlers/ (canonical) or app/tools/ (legacy).
definitions.mcp_tool: A tool exposed via Model Context Protocol. Canonical layer: app/icoder/mcp/handlers/.
definitions.domain_runtime: A medical-domain-specific runtime module. Currently one: app/coding_runtime/ (MedCodER 5-stage pipeline for Medical Coding). NOT a separate process.
definitions.execution_plane: The canonical agent execution layer. Currently: app/icoder/agent_runtime/. Includes InboundHandler, Orchestrator, Experts registry, Context, Memory.
definitions.platform_core: Cross-cutting infrastructure shared by all execution planes. Currently: backend/icoder_runtime/. Contains Registry, LLMGateway, DataPolicy, PII Redactor, RunHistory, AuditLog, FallbackTracker, ShadowDiffService, AgentPackageV1, CircuitBreaker, Guardrails.
definitions.registry: A bounded-context lookup table. Multiple registries are NOT duplicates if they serve different contexts.
definitions.schema_registry: A registry of protocol schemas (e.g., A2A SchemaRegistry for A2A v0.3 message schemas).
definitions.capability_registry: A registry of experts+tools that an orchestrator can dispatch to. Different from an agent registry.
